info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Position Management API
info.description: The Customer Position Management API allows for the efficient handling of customer position data within the banking domain. It enables authorized clients to record and update customer positions, ensuring real-time accuracy of financial information. This API serves banks and financial institutions that need to manage customer investment or asset positions effectively. Common use cases include capturing newly acquired assets or adjusting existing information to reflect market changes.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new position for a customer in the account management system. Ensure that all required fields are provided in the request body to successfully create a new position.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create or update a customer position within the account management system. It expects the data to be formatted as a JSON object, complying with the specified schema.
